name: swingle
description: Brings the model freedom of open harnesses to any driving harness, Claude Code and Codex among them: delegate a job to any provider CLI already installed on your machine (codex, claude, opencode, grok, pi, agy, omp, cursor-agent, devin, copilot), with advisory model preferences, provider notes, contracts, and an auditable ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Bring open-harness model freedom to any driving harness
interface.longDescription: Most harness controllers, Claude Code and Codex among them, expose only their own provider's models. Swingle backports the model freedom that open harnesses like opencode already have: it drives whichever provider CLI is already installed and authenticated on your machine (codex, claude, opencode, grok, pi, agy, omp, cursor-agent, devin, copilot), using advisory model preferences, provider notes, reusable contracts, and an auditable ledger.
